node.name: PID controller d
node.name_en: PID controller design procedure for spacecraft attitude control

definition: PID controller d：The design procedure involves: 1) Adjusting T_D to achieve the desired phase margin (PM) at a reasonably high frequency…
explanation: The design procedure involves: 1) Adjusting T_D to achieve the desired phase margin (PM) at a reasonably high frequency. 2) Setting T_I to a factor of 20 lower than T_D to avoid negatively impacting the phase at crossover. 3) Determining the gain K by plotting the compensated system amplitude with K=1, finding the amplitude value at the desired crossover frequency, and setting 1/K equal to that value.
